content.body: Nodes and edges independently track traversal statistics. Nodes record: traversal_count (total traversals), unique_traverser_count (number of unique visitors). Edges record: traversal_count, rating_avg (1–5 average rating, null when unrated), rating_count. Traversals are recorded via API calls POST /nodes/{id}/traverse or POST /edges/{id}/traverse. The MCP tool traverse_edge also increments counts. These figures reflect the actual frequency of knowledge usage, rather than merely recorded facts.
